categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Haoyuan Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main business segments: life science reagents (including molecular building blocks, tool compounds, and biochemical reagents), pharmaceutical intermediates and APIs (active pharmaceutical ingredients), and pharmaceutical formulations including CDMO services. The company provides integrated services covering drug discovery to commercial production, focusing on small molecule and new molecular types of drugs.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as high-activity API synthesis and purification, asymmetric synthesis, chiral catalysis, coupling technology, ozone oxidation, photochemical reactions, crystallization and polymorph screening, enzyme catalysis, fluorination, and click chemistry. It also employs high-throughput screening, fluid chemistry, biocatalysis, and continuous flow photochemistry. The company has developed proprietary compound libraries and platforms for ADC, PROTAC, peptides, nucleic acids, and solid-state chemistry, supporting drug discovery and industrial production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Haoyuan serves over 13,000 global partners including multinational pharmaceutical giants (Pfizer, JNJ, Lilly, MSD, Roche, BMS), top research institutions (NIH, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Tsinghua University, Peking University, Harvard, Oxford, Cambridge), and CRO companies. Its products and services cater to pharmaceutical R&D, clinical trial stages, and commercial production, targeting markets in China, the US, Europe, Japan, Korea, Singapore, and India.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with business hubs and sales teams in China (Shanghai, Anhui, Shandong, Chongqing), the United States (New Jersey), Europe (Germany), Japan, and other Asian countries. It has established overseas warehouses and a global supply chain network to support international customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Haoyuan operates across the pharmaceutical supply chain from upstream molecular building blocks and tool compounds, through midstream pharmaceutical intermediates and APIs, to downstream formulations and CDMO services. It provides integrated 'starting materials - intermediates - APIs - formulations' services, positioning itself as a full-cycle service provider in drug development and manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth, focusing on expanding compound libraries, advancing ADC, PROTAC, peptide, and nucleic acid drug platforms, and integrating AI technologies for drug discovery. It invests in green chemistry, continuous flow chemistry, biocatalysis, and digital transformation to enhance R&D efficiency and sustainability. Strategic priorities include global market expansion, brand building, talent development, and strengthening integrated service capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through product sales of molecular building blocks, tool compounds, biochemical reagents, APIs, intermediates, and formulations, combined with technical service fees from custom synthesis, process development, and CDMO services. Sales channels include direct sales and distribution, supported by online and offline marketing, targeting both domestic and international markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Haoyuan is a leading domestic player in small molecule drug R&D and manufacturing with a unique integrated front-end and back-end business model. It holds a strong position in tool compounds and biochemical reagents with significant international influence. The company is among the few capable of industrial-scale synthesis of complex APIs like Eribulin and is a pioneer in ADC payload-linker research in China, placing it in the first tier of the ADC and CDMO market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.27 billion, a 20.75% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 201.59 million, up 58.17%. Total assets grew by 31.31% to RMB 5.5 billion, and equity attributable to the parent increased by 14.7%. The company maintains a strong growth trajectory with expanding R&D investment and global market penetration.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Haoyuan offers a comprehensive, integrated service platform covering the entire pharmaceutical development chain, enabling faster and more efficient drug discovery and production. Its competitive advantages include a broad and innovative product portfolio, advanced proprietary technologies, high-quality global service networks, and strong R&D capabilities. The company emphasizes quality, innovation, and customer-centric service, providing differentiated, high-value products and customized solutions that accelerate clients' drug development and commercialization.
